scopes.setter: llama_set_adapters_lora host call alone under the context lock; the scheduler re-reservation it marks is paid by the next scoring call
scopes.first_scoring: one complete Scorer.score call over the workload directly after the binding step: prefix/state preparation, every suffix decode, logits read for every row
scopes.steady_scoring: the identical Scorer.score call repeated at once on the same binding (repeated identical request)
scopes.public_call: one public Judge.score(text, questions) call through the Runtime role binding on the first probe input
scopes.public_reload: the same public call on a pool limited to one adapter, so every switch evicts and reloads an adapter

synchronization: scoring timers stop after llama_get_logits_ith has read every scored row, which synchronizes the backend; the setter timer covers the host call
control: the same binding replayed without switching through the identical schedule of prefix-cache namespaces, in the same repeat
scope: fake-free native primitive measurement on standalone probe inputs; no check evidence, no specialist quality claim; correctness under deterministic probe adapters does not establish fitted-adapter accuracy
